instruction: Buy the highest-rated gaming console controller on amazon in 70-170 price range (ignoring tax and other fees) for each of my roommates and get them delivered to my home.
notes: Two-app task: phone.search_contacts(relationship=roommate) yields the number of roommates, which becomes the order quantity; amazon.search_products with product_type filter, min_price=70, max_price=170 and sort_by=-rating yields the highest-rated controller. The cart is cleared before adding the product so the placed order contains exactly num_roommates units of that single product (evaluation ignores CartEntry changes). Address and card ids are looked up via show_addresses/show_payment_cards; the existing home address is used (no address update/delete). Static facts login-username/token-for/search-spec pin the correct argument bindings; supervisor-complete-task takes the ordered record (product, quantity, address) as non-API parameters and must be last.
